description: Declared deploy bundle for the hermes-self-report cron. This file IS the bundle the installer copies; nothing outside its 'files' list is written. Canon bytes are the live mini copies (RC4) except postmark_send_report.py and hermes_self_report_delivery_probe.py, whose canon is the hermes-agent deploy mirror (live behavior + encoding=utf-8 on file opens). SKILL.md is authored in Brain and installed only with --include-skill --brain-path.

coexist_required.reason: hermes_report_build.compute_work_stoppage() does `import claim_store`; a missing copy degrades every work-stoppage verdict to UNKNOWN. Installer warns, never installs or removes it.
Read by the claim/snapshot-freshness logic. Runtime state, outside the bundle. Installer warns, never installs or removes it.

hermes_report_build._row_cost() imports spend_opencode.served_row_cost to strip subscription-covered (Codex OAuth) phantom spend from LEGACY writer-served rows (86e2hap1g). Owned by the spend bundle, not this one; a missing copy fails open to the raw recorded cost, so the digest over-reports rather than breaks. Installer warns, never installs or removes it.

files.role: load-bearing data-collection library imported by the builder as hermes_report_build_v1lib; its own table renderer is deprecated but the module is not retirable
compat-only orphan; no live importer (survey confirmed). Ships until a follow-up PR retires it after a final cross-surface caller check
standalone per-list ClickUp metrics CLI; no automated caller; live copy uses runtime-current venv path + lazy_secret_resolver token

RC4 delivery contract: venv re-exec, lazy token resolve, Postmark POST with in-code hermes-send fallback, receipt, nonzero-exit-on-total-failure. Canon = deploy mirror bytes (live behavior + encoding=utf-8)

receipt-reader probe for its own no_agent cron (offset from 0 */6 * * *): 0 fresh+sent, 1 both channels failed, 2 missing/stale/unreadable. Canon = deploy mirror bytes (live behavior + encoding=utf-8)
authored cron contract (Brain source of truth); installed only with --include-skill --brain-path <brain checkout>
